recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If ClinicalAssessment returns to core, or if the Patient Care incubator IG needs DiagnosticReport-specific guidance, handle that through a new work-group decision in the appropriate source; separately regenerate or review the stale DiagnosticReport SVG if diagram artifacts are in scope.
issue_request: FHIR-50441 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 change request to add ClinicalAssessment as a valid DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo.reference target for symptoms or differential-diagnosis input used in a diagnostic report.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as Applied and its comment says the change was added in PR 3494. Git history shows the actual one-line targetProfile addition in 1304849b7ac58cb333b4231cc87fe3a250fda615, with the Jira-linked 4905c05 commit on that PR branch.
additional_context: The later fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e source change removed ClinicalAssessment from DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo.reference and removed ClinicalAssessment from active fhir.ini registration as part of removing additional resources. Current fhir.ini has no active ClinicalAssessment resource entry, while current Observation narrative links ClinicalAssessment to the Patient Care incubator build. The DiagnosticReport SVG still displays ClinicalAssessment and GenomicStudy, but that generated-looking diagram is not the authoritative targetProfile source.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding ClinicalAssessment to current core DiagnosticReport would point an active core StructureDefinition at a resource no longer in the active current FHIR core build and would reverse later build-scope history without a new work-group decision.
